name: Duo Interpretation
prompts: Did the two work as a team?

tags.label: Partnership
tags.strength: You two worked as a true team.
tags.toWork: React to each other more, so it feels like one performance.

tags.label: Focus
tags.strength: Your off-stage focus was clean and steady.
tags.toWork: Keep your focus steady and off-stage during the piece.

tags.label: Characters
tags.strength: Each character was clear and different.
tags.toWork: Make each character more different in voice and body.

tags.label: Cutting
tags.strength: Your cutting told a complete story.
tags.toWork: Make the cutting tell a clearer, complete story.

tags.label: Intro
tags.strength: Your intro set up the piece well and named the title and author.
tags.toWork: Use the intro to set up the piece and name the title and author.

source: NSDA High School Unified Manual v2027.1.2, 2026-27 season. Summarized in our own words; no rule text copied.
